sources.title: CAA 2025 Aviation Consumer Survey, Wave 14
sources.locator: Q7 slide34/PDFpage33; methodology slide61/PDFpage60; publication CAP3213 dated26Feb2026
sources.claim: In October 2025, 3,500 UK adults were surveyed. Q7 reports top-three aviation-industry investment priorities: reducing cost 52%, airport queues 41%, disruption 36%, environmental impact 32%, ground access 29%.
sources.limits: Industry-investment priorities, not flight-choice weights, Flyji preferences, or a global ranking. Self-report; the detailed top-three question takes precedence over the executive summary. Search metadata incorrectly labels the PDF Wave13/2024; body and publication identify Wave14/2025.

sources.title: IATA 2025 Global Passenger Survey release
sources.locator: Mobile reliance, regional trends, About GPS
sources.claim: The release reports over10,000 responses from more than200 countries, growing phone use and regional differences, including North American emphasis on journey duration and fewer layovers.
sources.limits: Industry-published summary; full sampling/weighting details not audited here. No inference of Flyji audience size, causal behavior, or one universal priority.

sources.title: Google Flights official help
sources.locator: Find flights; flight insights; self-transfer tickets; missing flights
sources.claim: Documents city/airport input, date calendar, map discovery, stops/airline/time filters and booking handoff. It describes baggage and missed-onward-flight issues for separate tickets.
sources.limits: A product pattern and commercial context; no evidence that Flyji users prefer this interface or that any Flyji journey is purchasable.

sources.title: Heathrow connecting flights guidance
sources.claim: Transfer procedure depends on the booking and journey; separate tickets can require immigration, baggage collection/recheck and security.
sources.limits: Heathrow-specific contextual guidance. A city relation or generic elapsed gap cannot establish feasibility. Current instructions must be checked for the actual trip.

sources.title: WCAG2.2 W3C Recommendation
sources.claim: Contains keyboard, non-drag pointer access, minimum target-size, reflow and status-message criteria.
sources.limits: Using these criteria as requirements does not establish compliance. Full processes and human/assistive-technology evaluation remain necessary.

sources.title: GOV.UK planning user research rounds
sources.locator: Objectives; participants; prepare prototype; practice session
sources.claim: Research rounds need explicit objectives, suitable participants/access needs, informed consent, working prototypes and preparation.
sources.limits: Method guidance, not an aviation preference study or evidence that the proposed sample is sufficient.

sources.title: GOV.UK planning research for a service
sources.claim: Turn unsupported assumptions into research questions and adjust rounds as findings emerge; qualitative rounds and quantitative surveys require different sample planning.
sources.limits: No universal nine-person saturation threshold. Flyji recruitment, sessions and population estimates are still absent.

tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Unknown is distinct from zero; selected dates correctly constrain initial departure; recurrence is not inferred from sparse rows.
tasks.customer_prompt: Explore different departure days and explain what the available evidence says about service.
tasks.qa_actions: Use calendar/table alternatives and date range; explain daily-service inference.

tasks.title: Globe/flat map on phone

tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Correct dated choice and phase; schedule marker not interpreted as measured live position; pointer alternatives work; camera cost recorded.
tasks.customer_prompt: Understand where this route goes and when its legs occur; find a leg that is hard to see.
tasks.qa_actions: Locate a leg, Face/Fit, switch flat/sphere and time cursor; compare task effort with equivalent list.

tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Focus/status and complete task reviewed manually; automated checks are supporting evidence, not full WCAG conformance.
tasks.customer_prompt: Complete your search, comparison and change task using your usual input/access tools.

tasks.title: Network and historical inference

tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Unknown coverage cannot establish removal; normalized movement basis and comparable denominator visible; aircraft facts remain unknown unless sourced.
tasks.customer_prompt: Investigate this service-change question and explain the basis for your counts and conclusion.

tasks.customer_prompt: Retain a result so another person can understand and reproduce your explanation.
tasks.qa_actions: Export, restore/replay where available and explain method from artifact alone.

tasks.fixture: 1/10/100/1000 options and representative dense networks; slow response
tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.

tasks.customer_prompt: Find and inspect the options you need in this crowded or slow-response case.
tasks.qa_actions: Compare list paging, selected-context map and overview/detail; test loading/truncation and low-power fallback.

tasks.title: Stale saved selection
tasks.fixture: Saved flight rescheduled/cancelled, metadata revised and restored old snapshot
tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Old evidence visible; stale identities not silently substituted; explicit decision required before applying a change.
tasks.customer_prompt: Revisit this saved choice after new facts arrive; explain what remains valid and what changed.
tasks.qa_actions: Reopen, reevaluate, compare old/new and recover.

tasks.title: Constraints and failure recovery
tasks.fixture: Via/avoid conflict, invalid clock, network error and superseded request
tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Draft/applied query distinction clear; no silent relaxation; latest state coherent; logs identify actual failure and recovery.
tasks.customer_prompt: Correct a problem in this exploration without losing the useful work you have done.
tasks.qa_actions: Correct the query, relax explicitly, retry, undo and preserve comparison.

tasks.title: Personal and access circumstances

tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Capture unmet requirements and authoritative confirmation path; accessible app does not imply accessible journey.
tasks.customer_prompt: Explain how these options fit the requirements of your party and what still needs confirmation; include conflicting needs.
tasks.qa_actions: Ask what must be known before accepting a route; avoid collecting irrelevant sensitive details.

tasks.title: Door-to-door and environmental tradeoffs

tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Cannot rank door-to-door time or emissions without supported values/method; establish whether missing components prevent useful decisions.
tasks.customer_prompt: Compare getting to the actual destination using these alternative airports or transport assumptions.
tasks.qa_actions: Compare component breakdown and unknown indicators against airport-only ranking.

tasks.title: Ticket/booking scope
tasks.fixture: Separate vs through-ticket, baggage/cabin/inventory/terms unknown
tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: No purchasability or protection inference; evaluate whether contextual links help without claiming inventory reconciliation.
tasks.customer_prompt: Explain what would still need confirmation before purchasing or using this candidate.
tasks.qa_actions: Ask what an itinerary proves; attempt handoff or confirmation with existing source.

tasks.title: Enthusiast learning and return interest
tasks.fixture: Recent real enthusiast activity; self-directed time after tasks
tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Separate stated enjoyment/novelty from task value and future actual return; schedule illustration/track distinction retained.
tasks.customer_prompt: Investigate a flight question you find interesting and retain something useful from it.
tasks.qa_actions: Compare globe, timetable and network discovery; ask what they would use again and observe chosen task.

tasks.title: Locale and privacy
tasks.fixture: Ambiguous numeric dates, translated names, local save/share and account-free use
tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Correct date/place interpretation, explicit share boundaries; privacy preferences gathered without generalizing from biometrics survey.
tasks.customer_prompt: Interpret these places/dates and explain what is retained or disclosed when saving or sharing.
tasks.qa_actions: Explain labels/time conventions and what becomes visible when saving/sharing.

tasks.title: Explore, select and compare flight options
tasks.fixture: Owner-directed exploration task; identical dated choices including a shared edge, different local days and an interesting seed flight
tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Useful question/answer stated by the participant; exact flight/journey scope understood; comparison preserves IDs and reference; no claim of actual customer success yet.
tasks.customer_prompt: Explore these dated options, choose something worth understanding, compare alternatives and keep a useful insight.
tasks.qa_actions: Let people browse and choose their own question, then compare list/time, linked map and globe placements. Select an individual flight and a whole journey; pin alternatives and return to a reference.

tasks.title: Play with alternatives reversibly
tasks.fixture: Date/gap/hub variations, retained prefix and later commitment; invalid/dead-end option
tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Visible applied/draft scope and changed identities; no silent commitment replacement; recovery actually computed under stated bounds; observe surprise and exploration effort.
tasks.customer_prompt: Try a change to a date, wait or next leg that interests you; explain the consequences and return to the original when desired.
tasks.qa_actions: Compare preview/apply with direct reversible edits. Change one constraint, explain each changed leg, cancel/undo, and try a computed recovery.

tasks.title: Analyze an interesting flight cohort
tasks.fixture: Selected flight with alternative departure/arrival times, marketed duplicates and incomplete carrier/date coverage
tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Correct units, local dates, selection and cohort/query scope; no hidden best score, doubled movement or unsupported completeness. Count useful comparisons and interpretation errors separately.
tasks.customer_prompt: Analyze a meaningful difference among these options and explain which facts or constraints account for it.
tasks.qa_actions: Compare aligned lanes, tradeoff chart/matrix, selected/context geography and progressive evidence. Explain what a highlighted filter changes.

tasks.title: Keep exploration fluid across views
tasks.fixture: Long-haul/polar option, occluded map item, phone, keyboard, non-drag input and exploration history
tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: State and focus remain predictable; view/camera do not mutate query; facts/history remain dated; actual device/access effort and delight are observed separately.
tasks.customer_prompt: Start an exploration of your own, learn what can be changed and move between useful details without losing your place.
tasks.qa_actions: Move between option, leg detail, schedule, map/globe and evidence; use next/previous/event controls and backtrack. Compare progressive analytical detail.

tasks.title: Stay lengths and per-gap intent
tasks.fixture: Ordered multi-city/return case; local-night versus elapsed stay; later fixed leg and different rules per gap
tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Whole sequence is date-consistent; local nights not silently treated as elapsed24hours; exact locks honored or conflict disclosed; infeasibility distinct from unknown coverage; current engine does not promise all these constraints.
tasks.customer_prompt: Construct a sequence matching these local stays, return date and fixed commitment; explain any conflict.
tasks.qa_actions: Express leave/stay constraints, edit one gap and compare sequence/builder inputs; distinguish hard rules from preferences.

tasks.title: Historical operational reliability
tasks.fixture: Matched flight/operator/time cohort with actual delay/cancellation evidence and missing observations
tasks.method: Unprompted outcome task first using customer_prompt. Log hints and interpretation probes separately; qa_actions are later prescribed functional checks, not evidence of discoverability.
tasks.truth_and_observation: Future reliability not inferred from a timetable; sample basis/period/missingness and scheduled-vs-actual truth clear; no unvalidated probability or guarantee.
tasks.customer_prompt: Explain what these schedule and historical operational facts establish about disruption, including what remains unknown.
tasks.qa_actions: Inspect a route reliability question and compare schedule-only facts with operational summary if sourced.

proposals.title: Task entry
proposals.proposal: Compare compact universal query, three task/action entries and contextual actions from a place/flight/result, sharing state. Within each compare trip/date, geography/network and service/evidence representations. Do not ask for a persona.
proposals.counterargument: Task modes can hide functions or fragment context; a universal workspace may suffice.

proposals.title: Globe role
proposals.proposal: Preserve optional globe, flat map and complete list/time equivalents; compare initial placement across all three visual treatments.
proposals.counterargument: Optional can become undiscoverable; globe appeal may not offset camera cost or occlusion.

proposals.title: Time semantics
proposals.proposal: Separate search dates, arrival deadline and illustrative schedule cursor; always pair local endpoint dates with elapsed waits.
proposals.counterargument: Dense clocks can impair scanning; a single UTC reference is expert-friendly but insufficient for traveler days.

proposals.title: Transfers
proposals.proposal: Keep exact airport vertices and directed sourced/assumed ground allowances; state unverified ticket/processing facts beside transfer decisions with expandable detail.
proposals.counterargument: Too much warning overwhelms; hiding unknowns lets timing fit look guaranteed.

proposals.title: Flexible editing
proposals.proposal: Preserve prefix and rebuild suffix with visible changes and exact Undo; separately test downstream locks and per-gap policies.
proposals.counterargument: Auto-update can overwrite user intent; locks can create complex conflicts or dead ends.

proposals.title: Evidence and empty states
proposals.proposal: Distinguish coverage, source status, row loading, search limits and refresh time; unknown coverage cannot prove absence.
proposals.counterargument: Persistent evidence detail can overwhelm; counts or refresh timestamps may falsely look exhaustive.

proposals.title: Exploration value and commercial boundary
proposals.proposal: Put exploring, selecting, analyzing and reversible what-if play first across the three audiences; evaluate useful insight and retained decisions. Keep traveler price, inventory and personal transfer needs explicitly unanswered and test when these block bounded exploration.
proposals.counterargument: An unpriced explorer may fail the actual purchase decision even if its schedule tasks pass.

proposals.title: Inclusive plain interaction
proposals.proposal: Use standard concise headings, progressive detail and complete keyboard/screen-reader/non-drag equivalents; audit whole tasks.
proposals.counterargument: Concise/geeky may mean unexplained codes, tiny targets or hidden state; accessibility cannot rely on automated scores.

proposals.title: Research identity
proposals.proposal: Keep operating/marketing identity and scheduled/actual bases distinct, compare matched covered cohorts and export frozen evidence/method.
proposals.counterargument: Raw exports can be mistaken for normalized/exhaustive data; observed tracks cannot fill schedule gaps automatically.

proposals.title: Iteration and scope
proposals.proposal: Follow O08 option exploration with small falsifiable slices; keep comprehensive questions, actual dissent and version-specific QA. Continue on new evidence, never vote missing customer or owner evidence into consensus.
proposals.counterargument: An endless internal debate creates process without customer learning; wide feature scope creates a toolbox nobody understands.
